claim_checks.claim: LEAP|28 targets confirmed; total growth upgraded to double-digit CAGR 2027-28
claim_checks.finding: CMD 22-Sep-2026 (per Q3 release): LEAP|28 (2024-28) mid-to-high single-digit organic growth confirmed; total revenue CAGR at constant currency upgraded from high-single digit to double-digit for 2027-2028 (stronger M&A); consistent margin improvement; >90% cash conversion; leverage 1.5x-2x for 2027-28 (from 1x-2x); double-digit shareholder returns; EUR1bn AI-driven revenue ambition by 2030; c.21% portfolio rotation (TARGET).
No change: FY2026 guidance (mid-to-high single-digit organic, margin improvement at cc, strong cash flow) confirmed on 21-Oct-2026. 9M organic 5.7% sits at the low end of 'mid-to-high'.

Wendel 16-Sep-2025: after placing the 23.3m shares underlying the 2026 exchangeable bond, Wendel's holding fell from 26.5% of capital / 41% of votes to c.21.4% of capital and c.35% of voting rights. Shares under the Mar-2025 prepaid 3-year forward sale (6.7% of capital) settle in 2028 and remain in that 21.4% until then (INFERENCE: ~14.7% after settlement). No 2026 update on the stake found.

China revenue share not disclosed in releases read; APAC c.30% of revenue. Q3-26 cites strong activity in China and a 'sourcing shift back to China' in Consumer testing; 2024 divested China construction supervision business (c.EUR30m).
Effective 1-Jul-2026 reporting moved to four divisions; exits of Oil & Petrochemicals, Coal Testing & Inspection and Government Services planned/under way.
